August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 184)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network and regional radio, Barbara Luddy and Les Tremayne starring in two First Nighter Program romantic comedies for Campana's Italian Balm, Robert Trout anchoring historic live coverage of the Allied Third Fleet anchoring in Sagami Bay, Chuck Schaden interviewing Lurene Tuttle, and two countdown editions of Lucky Strike's Your Hit Parade (1936–1975):

Alt: Units Of The US Fleet Are In Sagame Bay, Sagami Bay		 "Allied Fleet Enters Sagami Bay (Robert Trout & Bill Downs — CBS World News)" CBS (WABC)
1945-08-26
2:00 PM EWT		 Sustaining
CBS News Special Report		 Robert Trout (Anchor), Bill Downs Paul White, Hugh Conover ["News", "Historical", "Wartime", "Military", "Live"] "CBS World News Today! Reporting live from the CBS newsroom in New York and aboard Allied warships anchored in Japanese waters!" Robert Trout anchors historic live eyewitness coverage as the United States Third Fleet and British Pacific Fleet drop anchor inside Sagami Bay under Mount Fuji in preparation for the formal Japanese surrender aboard the USS Missouri.
